# family-history

> Codename for a Spanish-first, open-source (AGPL-3.0-only) family-history platform by
> Innovaciones MADFAM. Families build their tree from evidence and keep their living memory:
> stories, voice interviews, photos and documents. Built for Mexican and binational families
> first. Status: incubating; build waves 1 and 2 on main, not deployed; see docs/HONEST_STATUS.md.

Boundary checkpoint (2026-10-01): public repository. Operational detail lives in MADFAM's private
internal-devops repository under the repo-boundary contract.

## Invariants

- This repository holds synthetic data only: no real person, family, photo, CURP or RFC.
- Living people are private by default (the 110-year rule). Nothing about them is ever public.
- Facts are assertions with citations. AI produces suggestions, never facts.
- Export is free at every tier: GEDCOM 7, GEDZIP, GEDCOM 5.5.1 and native JSON.
- Identity comes from Janua (RS256, audience `family-history-api`). LLMs go only through Selva.
  No provider keys in this repo.
- Never: DNA, CURP collection, data sale, voice or face cloning of real people.

## Code

- `api/src/family_history/`: Python service and the pure genealogy library
- `apps/web/`: Next.js landing and app
- `packages/contracts/`: generated OpenAPI and schemas
